label: TP
reason: User input from 'Referer' header is retrieved and processed via a Base64 encode/decode cycle (which preserves XSS characters) before being written directly to the HTML response body ('text/html') without any HTML entity encoding. Additionally, the 'X-XSS-Protection' header is explicitly set to '0', disabling browser-based XSS mitigations.

evidence.note: Transformation: Base64 encode/decode preserves special characters (XSS vectors).
Sink: Unsanitized data written to HTML response body.
Mitigation Failure: 'X-XSS-Protection' header set to '0' disables browser safeguards.
